messages:
maria-sales: Heads-up: Legal for BankX asked for a clear subprocessor ownership map + dataflow for the EU POC. Need to assemble artifacts by EOD tomorrow. Any volunteers? TL;DR they want who touches customer data, where (regions), and proof of contracts.

nate-se: I can pull the dataflow and subproc list. Will target a simplified diagram + CSV of subprocessors. Is pseudonymization at ingress required?

anya-legal: Legal wants: 1) Dataflow diagram annotated with region boundaries, 2) subproc list with jurisdiction + contractual clause reference (DPA section), 3) KMS/key custody details. Also need SOC2 control references. Prefer minimal export.

devops-ops: We have redwood-poc-dataflow-v1.pdf in the POC drive. It's a full stack diagram but includes AWS account IDs — will scrub before sharing. I'll produce a sanitized version.

oliver-ml: Note: For embeddings we route to eu-central by policy; ephemeral cache stored in worker GPUs only. Add that to the diagram. Also mention fallback to a quantized model in us-west for capacity.

sam-engineer: Adding subprocessor_matrix.xlsx (internal) — includes GCP/CloudFront vendors. I'll export CSV with columns: vendor, role, region, contract_clause, contact.

maria-sales: Perfect. Can we also include a short statement on data residency guarantees for the POC (no logs retained >7 days, KV cache ephemeral)? legal said they'd prefer concrete retention numbers.

anya-legal: We can state: request logs stored 7 days, traces 30 days, customer data persisted only per customer setting. Need exact S3 buckets prefixes and KMS key alias if possible.

devops-ops: S3 prefixes: s3://redwood-poc-eu-customer-data/ (pseudonymized), logs: s3://redwood-poc-logs-eu/. KMS alias: alias/redwood/poc/eu. Will confirm with infra.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Artifact upload completed: redwood-poc-dataflow-v1-sanitized.pdf (link: https://files.redwood.ai/poc/2038023456/redwood-poc-dataflow-v1-sanitized.pdf)

nate-se: I'll assemble a 1-page summary for the sales deck + the sanitized diagram and CSV. ETA: 6 hours.

maria-sales: :thumbsup: Please cc me and put files in the shared deal folder (sales/BankX/POC). Also flag any third-party subproc in US or Israel — security flagged those.

oliver-ml: We have one telemetry vendor (metrics.io) in US — it's used for infra metrics only. I'll add justification and minimal dataflow.

anya-legal: If metrics.io sees any customer-identifying fields, we need a DPIA. Ensure logs are hashed before export. If not, include statement 'no PII exported to metrics.io'.

sam-engineer: Quick ask for infra: can we add a minimal network egress map for BankX? legal requested to show egress IP ranges and destinations.

devops-ops: Yes. Block: current POC uses NAT gateway ip range 35.201.12.0/24 and 34.89.77.128/26 (eu-central). I'll paste the curl to verify from a worker: ```curl https://ifconfig.co```

maria-sales: Thanks team. Last: Pricing question from procurement: will Dedicated pricing apply for a 3-week POC? Sales wants quick answer.

nate-se: Short answer: POC pricing usually charged at hosted rates with an option to apply credit if converting to Dedicated within 30 days. I'll confirm with finance and reply in thread.

anya-legal: Once artifacts ready, I'll draft a one-paragraph statement for the DPA attachment. Send to me the sanitized diagram + subproc CSV.

maria-sales: Great. I'll follow up with BankX to schedule review tomorrow 09:00 CET. Please ping here when final files are uploaded.
